title: GuidanceContractsV1
description: Canonical fishing-agent contracts. Persisted envelopes require schemaVersion. HTTP hints may omit it.

WindBucket.description: Wind speed bucket. Independent of CompassDirection.

WindDirectionBucket.description: Empirical wind-direction grain. VARIABLE is not a CompassDirection.

OriginalPlanStep.description: Immutable original trip-plan stop. Plan-step and physical ids do not change; progressStatus is a session overlay rebuilt each snapshot.

progressStatus.description: Session waypoint progress names as strings.

TriggerRoutingDecision.description: Router/evaluator enqueue decision. Empty Optional means do not write outbox. reasonCodes are diagnostic codes and must not encode GuidanceAction values.

noBiteMinutes.description: Effective FISHING-window effort minutes since last BITE or FISH_ON. Excludes TRANSIT, PAUSED, and UNKNOWN.

adHocFishingStopId.description: Open USER_AD_HOC stop id. Absent when not fishing ad-hoc.

adHocStartedAt.description: When the open ad-hoc stop started. Absent when not fishing ad-hoc.

fishingTargetId.description: Best-effort GIS match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

physicalZoneId.description: Best-effort GIS zone match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

lakeFeatureId.description: Best-effort GIS lake-feature match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

PackageCooldown.description: Package-member cooldown after a fished visit leave. POINT/PATH: atomic identity of that visit. ZONE: that visit's packageMemberIds. Not actual-member consumption; disjoint packages on the same physicalZoneId stay eligible.

OpportunityRevisitSlice.description: Bounded package-member cooldown slice (cap 8, newest last; Java truncates). Not an actual-member consumption ledger. Missing/null deserializes empty. lastMoveTargetTripWaypointIds are recent delivered MOVE targets for MOVE_OSCILLATION.

originalPlanSteps.description: Full ordered original trip waypoints. Not replaced when a GuidancePlanVersion exists. Not required on old replay JSON.

activeGuidanceTargetTripWaypointId.description: Latest committed guidance MOVE target. Null/missing deserializes absent (STAY, none, or degraded). Backend arrival/effort/catch and RN must follow the same id; fallback is the original NAVIGATING waypoint.

adHocFishingStopId.description: Open USER_AD_HOC stop id. Absent when not fishing ad-hoc.

adHocStartedAt.description: When the open ad-hoc stop started. Absent when not fishing ad-hoc.

fishingTargetId.description: Best-effort GIS match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

physicalZoneId.description: Best-effort GIS zone match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

lakeFeatureId.description: Best-effort GIS lake-feature match on the open ad-hoc stop. Absent when unmatched.

originalPlanSteps.description: Unclipped copy of the original trip-plan prior. Survives shortHorizon replacement in model input.

GuidanceClientHints.description: Non-authoritative client hints. Server state wins.

HistoricalPerformance.description: catchCount is an alias of landedCount. sampleSize is an alias of contributingSessionWaypointCount. When both members of an alias pair are present they must be equal. effortMinutes is a display field derived from fishingEffortSeconds.

OutcomeAttribution.description: Follow state is dimension-local. Use followedRecommendation + recommendationRole; do not treat decision-level followedPrimary as the only follow flag.

RetrievedMemory.description: Read-only retrieval result passed to FishingAgentContextBuilder. Not a second Historical/Live DTO.

EvalSuiteKind.description: Internal eval suite kind. SIMULATION is reserved; implementation is deferred.

ReplayMode.description: FROZEN_REPLAY uses recorded state/memory/tools/clock. COMPONENT_RECOMPUTE must list recomputed components.

EvalExecutionMode.description: Eval-only execution mode. Live Facade traffic is not this enum.

EvalCaseResultStatus.description: SKIP is not PASS. Coverage uses SKIP in the denominator only. UNSCORABLE is not success or failure: a replayed action or target that differs from the historically followed decision cannot use the historical outcome.

GuidanceSuccessKind.description: Strict guidance success is FISH_ON_SUCCESS only. BITE_SIGNAL_ONLY is not NO_FISH_SIGNAL. Landing is not a member.

RecomputedComponent.description: Closed set of components that COMPONENT_RECOMPUTE may rerun. Unlisted components stay frozen.

LearningQuarantineReason.description: Non-retryable learning-outbox quarantine reason. UNKNOWN_JOB_TYPE must not stay PENDING.

EvalComponentVersions.description: Versions of components used for an eval run. Missing versions stay omitted, not invented.

EvalCoverage.description: evalCoverage is loadedCases / attemptedCases when attemptedCases > 0. SKIP counts in the denominator and is not a pass. Omitted coverage is not 0.

EvalRun.description: Internal eval run envelope. Scenario fields are placeholders for a future SIMULATION suite. Not an HTTP resource.

EvalCaseResult.description: Internal case result. recordedOutcomeKind describes the original action only and must not be treated as shadow counterfactual success. A materially different replayed action or target is UNSCORABLE, not PASS or FAIL. There is no counterfactualSuccess field.

OnlineGuidanceMetrics.description: Derived online metrics. Rates are nullable when the denominator is unknown; never encode missing rates as 0. Hard release gates use unsafeDeliveredRate and invalidDeliveredWaypointRate only.

UsageTelemetry.description: Unknown token or cost usage is omitted or null, never numeric 0. Amounts require an explicit pricingVersion.

FrozenAgentRunSnapshot.description: Frozen replay input loaded from persisted agent_runs. context may be omitted when safety BLOCK skipped context build. Live data must not be mixed in.
